chunks: And say: 'O Lord, disembark me in a welcome place; and You are the best of deliverers.'

key_terms.أَنْزِلْنِي: Disembark me / Cause me to land
key_terms.خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ: The best of those who cause to land/descend

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'Anzilni munzalan mubarakan' mean in the context of supplication?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a supplication of Prophet Yaqub (Jacob) upon entering Egypt, or more broadly as a model prayer for believers seeking divine ease in all transitions. It highlights the concept of 'Munzil' not just as one who causes descent, but as the ultimate source of blessing in every stage of life, reinforcing reliance on God's providence during times of change and settlement.
